chapter_title: "Health Equity and Social Determinants of Health"
specification:
Type: microsim **sim-id:** dahlgren-whitehead-rainbow
**Library:** p5.js
**Status:** Specified Draw six concentric arc bands (upper hemisphere) representing, from innermost to outermost: (1) Age, Sex, Heredity [dark blue], (2) Individual Lifestyle Factors [orange], (3) Social and Community Networks [green], (4) Living and Working Conditions [teal], (5) General Socioeconomic, Cultural & Environmental Conditions [purple], (6) a label ring with the layer name. Each band is clickable. On hover, the band brightens and shows a tooltip with the layer name. On click, a panel to the right of the arc displays: the layer name as heading, a 2-sentence definition, and three concrete public health examples. A "Reset" button clears the panel. Responsive to container width.
